name: Word filter
summary: Mask or block the words and patterns you list, before a message is stored.
description: Checks every message as it is sent or edited, including bots, webhooks and other modules' posts. List words (matched as whole words, ignoring case) and regex patterns in the settings, then pick what happens: mask replaces each match with asterisks, block refuses the message and shows the sender your reason. Channels you list are left alone. The module sees only the message text and its channel, has no network, storage or posting, and runs inside a small time budget; patterns use a linear-time regex engine and are capped in number and size. If the filter fails, the message goes through unchanged and the failure shows on this page, unless you set the hook to refuse. Use /filter-test to try text against your rules without sending it.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Try the filter
permissions.description: See what the filter would do with some text, without sending it.

settings.label: Words
settings.help: Up to 100, separated by commas or new lines. Matched as whole words or phrases, ignoring case.

settings.label: Patterns
settings.help: Up to 5 regexes, one per line, ignoring case. Use + and * rather than large {n,m} counts.

settings.label: When something matches
settings.help: Mask replaces the match with asterisks. Block refuses the whole message.

settings.label: Block reason
settings.help: What the sender sees when a message is blocked.
settings.default: That message has a word this server filters.

settings.label: Exempt channels
settings.help: Channel ids the filter skips, separated by commas.

extension_points.name: filter-test
extension_points.description: Show what the filter would do with some text.

extension_points.name: filter-test
extension_points.description: Try text against the filter without sending it.
